title: Add values in a loop
summary: Solidity: Add values in a loop. Add through 4 instead.
introduction: A for loop repeats steps. Call answer() to add 1, 2 and 3. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Add values in a loop with Solidity

blocks.text: Paste one contract into Remix and choose compiler 0.8.24 or later in the 0.8 series. Deploy only to Remix VM for practice. Call the function named in the lesson; shown results are return values.

blocks.title: Add values in a loop

blocks.text: The total begins at zero. The loop adds 1, 2 and 3.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Unbounded loops can use too much gas in real transactions.
